record.statement: The framework recommends measures for organisations deploying AI agents across four dimensions: assessing and bounding risks up front (including limiting agents' autonomy and access to tools and data); keeping humans meaningfully accountable through human-approval checkpoints; technical controls across the agent lifecycle; and enabling end-user responsibility through transparency and training. It is described as 'a living document'.

source.instrument: IMDA Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI

effectiveDates.note: Launched at WEF Davos
Updated version (multi-agent systems, third-party agents, automation bias) per IMDA press release - confirmed only via Allen & Gledhill lead
